raw_definitions: Definisi : n dolar: ~ sign, tanda dolar; /feel, look/ like a million ~s, ( colloq ) /berasa, kelihatan/ + approp adj sekali: I can’t believe you’ve ever been sick. You look like a million ~s, saya tdk percaya yg kamu pernah sakit. Kamu kelihatan sihat sekali; the sixty-four thousand ~ question, soalan yg sukar dijawab. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
